monospace.usage: Activity logs, API Keys, Telegram IDs, OTP inputs

marketing.strategy: Bento Grid (Mode A) with aggressive asymmetry.

dashboard.grid: High Density Grid (Mode B) - tight gaps (gap-4).
dashboard.panels: Cardless or sharp 4px rounded borders with 1px border-white/10.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped for marketing, sharp/4px rounded for dashboard. Primary uses #EC4899 background. Never use generic 'blue'.
components.inputs: Solid #0F0F16 background, 1px white/10 border, focus ring with #EC4899.
components.activity_log: Terminal style: JetBrains Mono, #05050A bg, auto-scroll, colored prefix tags (e.g., [INFO], [RARE], [ERROR]).
components.tables: Dense rows. Hover states MUST have text color explicitly set (hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white).
components.toasts: Use Sonner. Position bottom-right. Dark theme.
components.modals: Used for OTP/2FA and 'Verification Required' blocker. Must use backdrop-blur-xl and solid bg-black/80 for the overlay. The modal itself should be bg-[#0F0F16].

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for floating navs and modal overlays. backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, 1px border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Apply to the active bot status card and 'Elite' pricing tier. An animated 1px gradient border.
visual_enhancers.glow: Subtle neon pink drop-shadow on primary active buttons: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(236,72,153,0.4)].
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the marketing hero section.

motion.hover: Elements lift (-translate-y-1), borders lighten, and glow intensifies.
motion.active_status: A small green dot with animate-pulse next to 'Running' status.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast (use text-shadow or gradients if needed).
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500 focus:outline-none on all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, inputs, links, and key status elements (e.g., data-testid='bot-status-indicator').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (Unbounded, Outfit, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts in index.html.
Install @phosphor-icons/react for icons. Do NOT use emojis for icons.
Use JS/JSX for all React components, do not use TypeScript/TSX.
DO NOT use 'teal green' or 'teal blue' (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Use the provided Cyber Yellow or Hot Pink accents.
For the Activity Log, implement a clean, auto-scrolling terminal-like view.
The 'Verification Required' modal must pause UI interaction until the user resolves it or clicks a fallback 'Pause Bot' action.
Implement real-time status indicators (Idle, Fishing, Verifying, Error).
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for elements with content inside them (like dropdowns or modals).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
